source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: As long as Aleya leads a unit, attacks by models in it get +1 on **[Hit rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls)** when the unit is under its **Starting Strength**, and in addition +1 on **[Wound rolls](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls)** when it is **Below Half-strength**.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 10 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

clauses.appliesTo: attacks by models in the led unit
attacks by models in the led unit
